name: review-gate
description: Reviews a branch before its pull request with parallel reviewer agents and checkers that vote, keeps every finding until it is fixed or dismissed with a reason, and refuses gh pr create and merge until the review passes.

depth.title: Review depth
depth.description: How many reviewers and checkers a round runs. auto picks by the change's risk: quick for docs, standard for most code, deep for paths that need a person.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model the reviewer and checker agents run on. inherit uses the session's model.
